data.name: Holiday Inn Express Manzanillo by IHG
data.address: Blvd Miguel De La Madrid: 424, Tapeixtles, Zona Industrial, 28239 Manzanillo, Col., Mexico
data.description:
In the Manzanillo Fondeport Industrial Area, this informal hotel is 5 km from the Pacific Coast beach and 9 km from Las Hadas Club de Golf.
The relaxed rooms feature desks, flat-screen TVs with cable channels, and free Wi-Fi, as well as coffeemakers and minifridges. Suites add living areas with pull-out sofas and kitchenettes. Cribs are available.
Complimentary perks include a breakfast buffet and parking. There's also an exercise room and a business center, both open 24/7, plus an outdoor pool.
